messages:
Nora (CS): Heads-up — Bluecrest renewal bumped into procurement. They want to shift 5 seats from Standard -> Sandbox (still 50 total), extend term by 90 days, and insist on a wet-signed PO only from their procurement vendor (no DocuSign). Theywant enablement next week. Need alignment on provisioning + invoicing.
Miro (AE): Who's the signer there? procurement@bluecrest.com or CFO? If it's procurement-only and they refuse e-sign, can we accept a scanned PO as interim?
Jenna (Finance): Vendor code BLUE-INTL on file. Finance can accept a scanned PDF with signature and PO number as backup, but accounting prefers PO# before recognizing revenue. We can issue a provisional invoice marked "pending PO". Need the exact bill-to legal entity and tax id.
Ravi (Legal): We're comfortable accepting scanned PO in exceptional cases if signed by an authorized buyer. I'll want the signer name + title on record and to add a short ack that DocuSign preferred but scanned PO accepted for this transaction.
Nora (CS): Customer rep said signer is "T. Nguyen, Procurement Manager" and will courier the wet-signed PO on Mon, but they can email a scanned copy today. They asked if we can open seats immediately for training.
OnboardBot: Recommendation: schedule onboarding and create training-only Sandbox accounts now; do not enable API keys or production exports until billing confirmed. We can flag accounts with "provisional" metadata.
Miro (AE): Can we create 5 sandbox seats and set hard quota limits? Also, what about billing suspension? Jenna?
Jenna (Finance): Yes — Finance will allow provisioning of training/sandbox seats with billing hold. I'll prepare a provisional invoice ("Invoice P-174955") and annotate "Billing pending receipt of PO #: will finalize upon PO." We need emailed confirmation from their AP (ap@bluecrest.com) or the scanned PO itself.
Ravi (Legal): I'll draft a 1-paragraph amendment: accepts scanned PO, notes final signature to follow, and states billing commencement tied to PO receipt. Share for quick approval.
Nora (CS): Action list: Miro to request scanned PO now, Jenna to prep provisional invoice, Ravi to draft amendment, Onboard to prep sandbox-only enablement plan.
docusign-bot: Tip: DocuSign reduces disputes and preserves signature audit trail. Template "Renewal - Seat Shift" available if customer reconsiders.
Miro (AE): Pinged procurement contact — they replied: "We will scan and email PO# BC-2024-901 by EOD. Couriered wet copy arriving next Tue." Sent follow-up offering DocuSign link; they declined.
Nora (CS): Update: scanned PO received via procurement@bluecrest.com (attached). PO#: BC-2024-901. It's signed by T. Nguyen. Dropping into contracts/bluecrest/ and tagging finance.
Jenna (Finance): Received. Please forward to finance@redwood and confirm billing entity: "Bluecrest Systems Ltd, UK, VAT 987654321" or US? We have two entities on file.
Nora (CS): Confirmed: UK entity. AP contact copied: ap@bluecrest.com. Forwarding now.
Jenna (Finance): Thanks. I'll remove provisional flag once PO is in our system and create final invoice with start date per PO. For now I'll issue P-174955 with note "no billing until PO processed."
Ravi (Legal): Shared amendment draft in thread (link). Please review quickly; it'll be attached to the contract and reflects scanned PO acceptance.
OnboardBot: Sandbox enablement scheduled Thu 10am UTC. Created 5 training seats with limited permissions and disabled exports. Will toggle prod perms once finance confirms.
Miro (AE): Thanks team. I'll confirm with Bluecrest that training slot is set and that full prod access will follow PO processing.
Nora (CS): Closing loop for now: training enabled, PO scanned and in system, finance prepping provisional invoice. Ravi to finalize amendment. I'll post final when prod seats are released. :white_check_mark:
